ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity pixels are limited to approximately 5-10% of the visible surface, appearing as isolated white clusters against a dominant low-intensity (black) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-contrast white circular ring blobs are concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe; sparse white punctate spots are distributed across the central and outer regions of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes are visible along the posterior boundaries of both lobes where not obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes follow a convex trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple circular white rings (high-contrast pixel clusters) on the upper right lobe, likely indicative of previous barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin white linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white rosette scars on the right lobe and small irregular notches along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'target-like' concentric circular white markings on the right fluke lobe.
